timing: Operationalizes the frozen protocol axes after primary inference started, before root or graders inspect any main response content. No new primary significance outcome is selected.
reference_rule: Use frozen question-specific required facts, numeric tolerances and scope rules; optional detail never becomes mandatory. Do not revise references from model answers.

case_fields.required_fact_assessments: One supported_correct/missing/incorrect/ambiguous classification per required fact with bounded rationale.
case_fields.reference_content_correct: All required facts answered correctly without contradictory material, regardless of whether the retrieved context contained them.
case_fields.scope_correct: The requested entity/period/quantity/sample distinction is correctly answered. Missing requested scope is incomplete, while an explicit wrong scope is also recorded as an error.
case_fields.citation_grounded: All essential asserted facts are supported by actual cited retrieved text; a page ID match without the needed chunk content is insufficient. Unlisted but valid source-supported alternatives may be recorded as explicit adjudication, not a reference edit.
case_fields.format_ok: Readable concise prose with interpretable document/page citations. Grouped citations accepted. No JSON/enumeration test. Longer-than-requested answers reported separately from content correctness.
case_fields.appropriate_abstention: Explicitly withholds unsupported requested content when context does not establish it; distinct from reference answer completeness.
case_fields.unsupported_assertions: List material claims absent from received context, including reference-correct facts inferred from prior knowledge. Do not conflate absence of citation with falsehood.
case_fields.native_output_budget_failure: Preserve native stop_type=limit as a separate bounded-output failure; do not rewrite or retry the response.

descriptive_aggregation: Report content, scope, citation and format separately, plus explicitly labelled joint content+scope+citation counts. Perquestion paired outcomes, denominators fixed; no IID accuracy, significance, prevalence or generalization claim from two histories.
error_attribution: Join independent context-only audit. Complete context with wrong/incomplete output is a reader issue; missing required context is a retrieval/representation limitation. Hallucinating under insufficient context is additionally a grounding failure.
no_recomputation: System instruction prohibits recomputing quantities; component sums without an explicitly supplied final value do not establish complete reference-value evidence. Unit-equivalent reporting of an explicitly supplied value is acceptable.
grading: Separate model-assisted domain reviewers inspect condition-masked cases with exact raw answers/context/reference. Method labels masked, not guaranteed statistical blindness; common project familiarity/source authorship disclosed. Root checks disagreements and ties.
raw_outputs: Retain untouched native responses externally with hashes; distribute scoring rationales/paraphrases and any source-copy-reviewed short output excerpts without replacing originals.
